evals.name: file-upload-architecture-quick
evals.prompt: Here is a capability breakdown for a file upload feature (from the solution-architect skill): users upload images and PDFs up to 10MB, the system validates them, scans for viruses, generates thumbnails for images, and stores them for retrieval (capabilities CAP-01 validation, CAP-02 upload/transfer, CAP-03 virus scan, CAP-04 thumbnail generation, CAP-05 storage/retrieval). Design the technical architecture and recommend the tech stack. Assume a small team and a typical web app.
assertions: Output contains 'Source Breakdown' section referencing the provided capabilities
Output contains 'Constraints & Assumptions' section
Output contains 'Architecture Overview' section with a named architecture style
Output contains 'Tech Stack' section
Output contains 'Capability → Tech Mapping' section
Output contains 'Key Architecture Decisions' section (ADR-style)
Output contains 'Research Suggestions' section
Output contains 'Open Questions' section
Output contains 'Next Steps' section
Depth level is marked as 'quick'
Tech stack covers at least frontend, backend, data storage, and hosting layers
Each tech stack layer gives a Recommendation, a Why/rationale, and at least one Alternative
Recommendations are opinionated (a single clear choice per layer, not an undifferentiated list)
Capability mapping covers all 5 provided capabilities (CAP-01..CAP-05)
Virus scanning (CAP-03) is addressed in the architecture (e.g., async scanning approach)
Thumbnail generation (CAP-04) is addressed (e.g., async/worker processing)
Object/blob storage is recommended for stored files
Describes HOW (technologies, architecture), NOT new features or capabilities
Does NOT invent new functional capabilities beyond the provided breakdown
Checks for the source breakdown via librarian skill, or works from the provided breakdown
Flags at least one choice for the researcher skill OR justifies that none are high-stakes
Does NOT attempt to persist/save the output — suggests librarian skill instead
Output ends with a suggestion to use the librarian skill for persistence
Document is written as a temporary draft (not persisted by the skill itself)

evals.name: subscription-billing-architecture-standard

Design the technical architecture and recommend a comprehensive tech stack. We're a 4-person team comfortable with TypeScript, expecting a few thousand customers in year one.
assertions: Output contains 'Source Breakdown' section referencing the provided capabilities
Output contains 'Constraints & Assumptions' section capturing team (TypeScript) and scale
Output contains 'Architecture Overview' section with a named architecture style and rationale
Output contains 'Tech Stack' section
Output contains 'Capability → Tech Mapping' section
Output contains 'Key Architecture Decisions' section with at least 2 ADR-style entries
Output contains 'Risks & Tradeoffs' section
Output contains 'Research Suggestions' section
Output contains 'Open Questions' section
Output contains 'Next Steps' section
Depth level is marked as 'standard'
Tech stack covers frontend, backend, data storage, auth, infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, and security layers
Each tech stack layer gives a Recommendation, a Why/rationale, and at least one Alternative
Recommendation adapts to the stated TypeScript team constraint (e.g., Node/TS backend)
Recommendation reflects the stated scale (does not over-engineer for millions when thousands are expected)
Capability mapping covers all 6 provided capabilities (CAP-01..CAP-06)
Payment processing architecture addresses a payment gateway integration (PCI handled by a provider, not storing raw card data)
Recurring billing / scheduled jobs are addressed for the billing cycle (CAP-04)
Async retry/dunning handling is addressed for CAP-06
Describes HOW (technologies, architecture), NOT new features or capabilities

evals.name: marketplace-architecture-deep

Do a comprehensive technical architecture and tech stack for the entire platform. Design for growth to millions of users.

Output contains 'Constraints & Assumptions' section capturing the large-scale target
Output contains 'Architecture Overview' section with a named architecture style and rationale appropriate for scale
Output contains 'Tech Stack' section
Output contains 'Capability → Tech Mapping' section
Output contains 'Key Architecture Decisions' section with multiple ADR-style entries
Output contains 'Risks & Tradeoffs' section
Output contains 'Research Suggestions' section
Output contains 'Open Questions' section
Output contains 'Next Steps' section
